newsitem.title: USA: World Bank insurance unit has jump in growth.
newsitem.headline: World Bank insurance unit has jump in growth.

text.p: The World Bank arm that provides investment guarantees against non-commercial risk said Monday its portfolio jumped to $2.3 billion in coverage in the year ended June 30 from $1.4 billion a year earlier.

The Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency, in its annual report, said it issued 68 investment guarantee contracts for $862 million in new coverage as against 54 contracts for $672 million in the prior year.

Noting that the agency's portfolio now encompasses investments in 40 developing countries, it said investment guarantees were issued for the first time in Kuwait, Kyrgyz Republic, Mali, Nepal, and Papua New Guinea.
Much of the funding was for infrastructure, including power and telecommunications. Net income in the year rose by 61 percent to $20.7 million before provisioning against future claims.
